comment: dungeon.c recalc_mapseen() sets flags.bigroom while a sighted hero is on the Big Room; that flag makes the level interesting to #overview and adds its 'A very big room.' line. A debug-mode Priest dismisses the welcome, level-teleports to depth 10, where seed 62401 places bigrm, then opens #overview. The seed, clock and character were chosen for this case.
